what: A 26px ring hotspot floating over video or a photo. On hover the 4px dot in the center shrinks to 2px and a 10px inner circle spreads from scale 0 → 1 (.6s cubic-bezier(.52,0,.48,1)). On press, the card named by aria-controls opens from transparent and 10px below in .6s (the char-blur-rise text inside comes into focus at .3s intervals), and pressing again, clicking outside or Esc closes it in .3s. Only one can be open at a time.

options.[data-fx-part=card]: (when there is no aria-controls) the card inside the button

from.where: index.html .fh-spot·.fh-card (original icon-cta: 26px ring·dot 4→2px·inner 10px scale 0→1, transition .6s [.52,0,.48,1] · card glass panel)

note: Card position is decided by the user (original: a 480×322 glass panel right below the hotspot, full width at the bottom of the screen on phones).
